classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish fractional grouping and apply reciprocal horizontal dilation factors and translations to obtain exact coordinates.

content.prompt: Let $P(10,y)$ lie on $y=f(x)$. Find the new $x$-coordinate of $P$ on each of the following.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(\frac{2}{3}\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)\right)\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac{3}{2}$, then translate left $\frac{1}{2}$ unit. The successive $x$-coordinates are
$$\begin{align*}x_1&=\frac{3}{2}(10)=15\\x_2&=15-\frac{1}{2}=\frac{29}{2}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(2\left(x+\frac{1}{6}\right)\right)\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac{1}{2}$, then translate left $\frac{1}{6}$ unit. The successive $x$-coordinates are
$$\begin{align*}x_1&=\frac{1}{2}(10)=5\\x_2&=5-\frac{1}{6}=\frac{29}{6}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(2\left(x-\frac{1}{4}\right)\right)\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac{1}{2}$, then translate right $\frac{1}{4}$ unit. The successive $x$-coordinates are
$$\begin{align*}x_1&=\frac{1}{2}(10)=5\\x_2&=5+\frac{1}{4}=\frac{21}{4}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(4\left(x-\frac{1}{8}\right)\right)\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac{1}{4}$, then translate right $\frac{1}{8}$ unit. The successive $x$-coordinates are
$$\begin{align*}x_1&=\frac{1}{4}(10)=\frac{5}{2}\\x_2&=\frac{5}{2}+\frac{1}{8}=\frac{21}{8}\end{align*}$$
